en.headline: Police warn of fake site offering ticket-fine discounts
en.dek: The force said a fraudulent site posing as the electronic traffic ticket platform seeks card and personal data, and that fines carry no early-payment discount.
body: Police said on Tuesday they had found a fraudulent website posing as the electronic traffic ticket platform. The site claims that paying a fixed-penalty ticket early brings a discount, and asks users for credit-card and personal details.

The force said there is no discount on ticket fines. After a driver enters a vehicle registration mark and the notice number on the official platform, the system lists details such as the date, time and place of the offence so they can be checked.

Police said electronic ticket messages are sent only under the sender name #HKPF-eTT, and that neither text nor email notices contain any link. Anyone who has given personal data to a fake site was asked to call the Anti-Deception Coordination Centre on 18222. Enquiries about the official platform can be made on 181 181.

zh.headline: 警方揭偽冒電子告票網站 稱早交罰款有折扣
zh.dek: 警務處說該網站誘使市民提供信用卡及個人資料，強調繳交告票罰款不設任何折扣，電子告票短訊亦不會附超連結。
body: 警務處星期二表示，發現偽冒「電子交通告票平台」的欺詐網站，聲稱提早繳交告票罰款可獲折扣優惠，誘騙市民提供信用卡及個人資料。
警方強調，繳交罰款不設任何折扣優惠。市民在官方平台輸入車牌號碼和定額罰款通知書編號後，平台會列出違例日期、時間及地點等詳情，供核對。
所有電子告票短訊只會由發送人名稱「#HKPF-eTT」發出，無論短訊或電郵告票都不會附有超連結。曾向偽冒網站提供個人資料的市民，可致電18222聯絡反詐騙協調中心；查詢平台可致電181 181。
